findings: Login renders without overflow and with 44px targets at five viewport widths
Password visibility can be toggled without changing its value and conceals on leaving the field
Failed sign-in displays a recoverable error and preserves email
Cross-origin authentication rejected
New device requires emailed code and resend is throttled
Expired and incorrect email codes cannot authenticate
Six-box PIN entry supports leading-zero paste, native editing, reveal and conceal
Password and email ownership verification lead to confirmed six-digit PIN setup, preserving leading zeroes
PIN setup and unlock have clean accessibility scans and no overflow at six widths in both themes
Verified-device PIN unlock works without email; unverified devices and unproven PIN changes are rejected
Verification code cannot be replayed
Login ticket is single-use and successful sign-in audited
Mobile navigation traps keyboard focus and closes with Escape
Real WebAuthn registration with required user verification succeeds
Real WebAuthn authentication opens an authorized workspace
PIN recovery requires password plus email, expires and cannot replay; reset rejects old PINs, sessions and outstanding tickets without duplicating the device
Personal Account Security lives in Settings for ungranted staff; business controls and writes remain denied; old account links redirect
A signed-in staff account has no operational or owner access before explicit grants
Individual grants persist and finance screen cannot be delegated
Permission changes apply to existing sessions and staff inventory JSON excludes buying costs
Individual permission editor saves grants through its actual browser controls
Additional Owner security lockout remains enforced and directs recovery to the server operator

Configured Owner provisions an audited Owner through the UI; that Owner verifies email and PIN, receives finance access, and both peers reject suspension, demotion, permission changes, deletion and device revocation

Generated and manual account passwords, credential emails and failure recovery, administrator reset, old-session/PIN/code invalidation, and employee/device method policies work through actual controls
Server-backed workspace lock blocks subsequent authenticated requests
Revoke ends access on the next API request
Concurrent wrong PINs stop at three failures, lock the account, revoke devices and alert the Administrator
limitations: Virtual authenticator validates WebAuthn protocol, not physical Face ID hardware.
Email uses a test-process transport; live provider delivery not exercised.
